title: Explore Houston’s Hip Hop Culture on a 100% Motorized Party Bike
includes: Play a round of Trill Trivia + Trap Karaoke
VIP Entrance at Bar Stops + Drink Specials
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: No refunds for bad weather, but we’ve got you covered! We’ll offer a raincheck for a future tour or try to reschedule for the same weekend.
You can bring beverages of choice (our tours are 100% BYOB)!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Trill On Wheels is Houston's original Black-owned hip-hop party bike. The first of its kind in the country, with nearly 5,000 five-star reviews and counting! 

Whether it's a birthday, bachelor(ette) party, girls' night, or date night, our 100% motorized party bike brings two hours of nonstop energy through Houston's Historic Third Ward. 

Your Trappin' Captain hosts the party with curated playlists from Houston legends, Trill Trivia, Trap Karaoke, LED lights, and VIP entry at legendary local bar stops. 

100% Motorized & 100% BYOB - Bring your drinks and we bring the vibes! Trill On Wheels riders get access to multiple signature tour experiences, exclusive rider upgrades, and a complete lineup of ways to customize your ride. See everything we offer @trillonwheels.
